reason: This decision covers the private SDK only. Host-owned proofs add no document record or shared field. Property proofs cover saved/current native bags; paragraph-mark proofs cover their complete native paragraph. Row and cell insertion/deletion proofs cover their complete native owner. Structural table receipts include their fresh native text and formatting dependencies. Pure table-format decisions remain separate from cell text. Existing unsupported kinds refuse atomically. This private decision changes no wire protocol, shared schema, native format, or published API.
